question: Which religious group of people celebrates the Nowruz festival in India ?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Parsis.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Nowruz is a festival that marks the Persian New Year and is celebrated by Parsi communities in India.**
 
• Parsis are followers of the **Zoroastrian religion, which originated in ancient Persia (modern-day Iran) and was brought to India by Persian immigrants.** 
 
• The festival usually falls on or around **March 21st and is celebrated with feasting, dancing, and the exchange of gifts.**
 
• Nowruz is also celebrated in other countries with significant Persian and Zoroastrian populations, such as Iran, Afghanistan, and Tajikistan. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Jews celebrate Hanukkah, Passover, and other religious holidays. 
 
• Buddhists celebrate Vesak, the birthday of Buddha, as well as other festivals specific to different Buddhist traditions.
 
• Jains celebrate Mahavir Jayanti, the birth anniversary of the founder of Jainism, as well as other important dates in the Jain calendar.
